findings.title: Finished crew neck opening = 35.0cm; will NOT pass an adult head (~56cm) in a NON-STRETCH woven
findings.detail: The finished neck opening perimeter is 35.05cm (= neck body measurement, ease +0.5mm). There is no zipper, placket, tie or back opening. To pull a crew tank over the head, a WOVEN (non-stretch) neckline must be >= head circumference (~55-57cm) or need a closure. 35cm woven -> ~20cm short -> cannot be donned. The engine's wearability guard does NOT fire because it only catches a COLLAPSED opening below 150mm (documented: finished perimeter is too noisy a head oracle to threshold higher). So this passes internal tests but is a real donning risk on woven.
findings.mm: opening 350mm vs head ~560mm = -210mm deficit for woven
findings.resolution: The reference garment (Elle tank) is a KNIT tank. Recommendation shipped in the package: sew the sample in a light STRETCH KNIT (jersey/rib, 180-240 g/m2) where 35cm stretches over the head. If woven is required, the neck opening must be enlarged or a small back button/keyhole added. This is a spec/fabric decision, NOT a draft-geometry bug. Motor NOT touched (constraint).

findings.title: Front armhole 12.1mm longer than back armhole
findings.detail: By design for a sleeveless block (front armhole deeper). They are each bound separately, not sewn to each other, so this is not a seam mismatch. Bias binding total (1096mm) already accounts for both. No action.

findings.title: Contract spec has shaping=null but the shipped sample uses shaping=dart
findings.detail: A truly boxy/oversized crop tank would typically have NO waist dart (straight boxy body). The darted draft adds a front + back waist dart. This is a design choice, not a defect; the sample pack (gen-pack.mjs) uses dart, so this audit follows it. Flag for Damla: decide dart vs dartless for the boxy silhouette.

tailor_verdict.reason: All true seam pairs match within 0.12mm; head goes through in stretch knit (35cm opening stretches); movement ease adequate (boxy, +5.8cm bust); sewing order locks cleanly (staystitch -> darts -> shoulders -> bind neck -> side seams -> bind armholes -> hem, no step blocks a later one); all raw edges finished (bias binding neck+armholes, double-fold hem); flat garment matches the pattern.
tailor_verdict.conditional: If the tailor uses NON-STRETCH WOVEN, mark DIKILMEZ-as-drawn (head will not pass) -> use knit, or enlarge neck / add back closure.
